name: com.ware.maqui
description: A reactive MVVM UI framework for Unity. R3-powered ViewModels, VitalRouter command routing, and layer-based window management.

samples.description: A minimal Hello World scene demonstrating Maqui routing and MVVM basics.
A multi-screen showcase demonstrating navigation, theming, and reactive bindings.
An inventory/item list demo showing reactive lists and detail views.
A before/after demo showing how to migrate existing OneUI views to the Maqui MVVM pattern.
